How can I become a member of the Alumni Association?
To become a member of the Alumni Association, please visit our website and follow the membership registration process. You can also contact our association's office for assistance.
What benefits do alumni association members receive?
Alumni association members enjoy various benefits, including access to exclusive alumni events, networking opportunities, career support, and updates on college activities and achievements.
How can I stay updated on alumni events and activities?
To stay informed about alumni events and activities, make sure your contact information is up-to-date with the association. Additionally, follow our official social media accounts and subscribe to our newsletters.
Can I contribute to the college's and students growth?
Absolutely! We welcome contributions from alumni to support scholarships, mentorship programs, and infrastructure development. Contact us to explore how you can make a positive impact.
Do alumni have chances to mentor current students?
Yes, we encourage alumni to mentor and guide current students. If you're interested in becoming a mentor, please reach out to us, and we'll connect you with the relevant programs.
How can I network through the alumni association?
You can reconnect with classmates and expand your network by attending alumni events, joining our LinkedIn group, and actively participating in our alumni community. These platforms provide excellent opportunities to connect with fellow alumni.
